fusions.name: Burning Glass
fusions.desc: Focuses a beam through a lens onto a target up to 8 tiles away that deals 15 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach. It burns away every affliction you have on the target and deals 50% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Dazzle
fusions.desc: A flare of white flame that deals 11 damage to everything within 3 tiles ahead of you, stuns each target for 1 second and leaves it [Blunted], its critical hit chance lowered, for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Watchtower Beacon
fusions.desc: Lights a beacon where you stand for 14 seconds. Every 1.5 seconds its beam burns an enemy within 7 tiles, which deals 4 damage with a 40% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Held Focus
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on that enemy, up to 10. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: a beam of focused heat strikes it for 27% of your weapon damage per stack (272% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
